classification: MODELLED reanalysis demonstrator sample; not station observations

cross_source_check.basis: UTC, matched by timestamp; first source minus second source

interpretation: Sample statistics for one grid cell and one calendar year, not instantaneous design extremes, region-wide bounds, replay limits or safety thresholds. Hourly reanalysis smooths terrain and the coast.

licence_and_attribution.approval_statement: No approval of demonstrator, downstream or production reuse is asserted; owner and legal confirmation remain pending.

nasa_power.attribution: The data was obtained from the POWER Project's Hourly 2.x.x version on the retrieval date.
nasa_power.published_terms: Referencing guide asks for the POWER data reference with service, version and access date (https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/referencing/, read 2026-10-22). No licence text was retrieved: the NASA data information policy page returned HTTP 403.

open_meteo.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0, link to https://open-meteo.com/, indicate that values were summarised; underlying ERA5 reanalysis is Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) material.
open_meteo.published_terms: Open-Meteo API data are offered under CC BY 4.0; the free API is for non-commercial use under 10,000 calls per day (https://open-meteo.com/en/terms and https://open-meteo.com/en/licence, read 2026-10-22).

percentile_rule: Sorted values, rank p*(n-1), linear interpolation between neighbouring order statistics
production_pending: station-grade or authorised source (for example MIDAS via an authorised account)
licence and commercial-use confirmation, including underlying C3S terms
precision against observations for the North East

rejects: humidity inconsistent with temperature and dew point
